questions.key_step: Recognise 0/0 and derivative at a point.
questions.justification: Single familiar move (0/0 and derivative at a point), like 2024-P2-Q3.

questions.key_step: Peel nested inverse trig functions to (1-x)/(1+x).
questions.justification: Routine chain of inverse-trig simplifications, then a derivative and option check; no insight beyond the substitution.

questions.key_step: Half-angle squares and the sign of the moduli; principal value of cot^-1.
questions.justification: Routine half-angle simplification; the only care is the modulus signs and principal value.

questions.key_step: Exponentiate; two rounds of implicit differentiation at x=0.
questions.justification: Two routine implicit differentiations with a numerical answer (no options to check).

questions.key_step: Reach sqrt(x^2-1) y' = 4y then differentiate again.
questions.justification: Needs the squaring trick to remove y^{1/4} and a second derivative; numerical answer with no options, ideas moderately familiar.
One familiar move: L'Hospital with f(1)=9 and a polynomial derivative.

questions.key_step: sec t - tan t = tan(pi/4 - t/2) with range check.
questions.justification: Standard sec-tan simplification, range check and option testing.
Textbook derivative of the inverse; guess x=4.

questions.key_step: Repeated differentiation and subtraction to get f''(1); f(1)=0.
questions.justification: Less familiar: repeated differentiation of the relation, and f(1)=0 implicit in the existence of the limit; multi-step.
Routine: write y=2cos(5 ln x/5) and differentiate twice; match option.

questions.key_step: Expand determinant, quadratic in a, Vieta.
questions.justification: Determinant expansion, derivative and Vieta - a short routine chain.

questions.key_step: Differentiate functional equation in x and in y, solve for f'(2),f'(4).
questions.justification: Functional equation: differentiate both ways and combine; numerical answer with logs; moderate idea availability.

questions.key_step: Log differentiation and second derivative of inverse.
questions.justification: Logarithmic differentiation and second derivative of the inverse; numerical, precision risk (sign/product rule).

questions.key_step: Change of base and quotient rule at pi/4.
questions.justification: Change of base then quotient rule at a symmetric point; routine.

questions.key_step: cos3t and sin3t from product derivatives; second derivative parametric.
questions.justification: Product derivatives collapsing to cos3t/sin3t, second parametric derivative and evaluation; several steps but options help.

questions.key_step: alpha=sqrt2; two implicit differentiations with u=x^2-y^2-1=-1.
questions.justification: Long implicit second derivative with a fifth power; numerical, a slip changes the answer.
